component: Compose identity selection and close-state contract

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The identity dropdown calls LoadIdentity(false), which no longer resets editor modification count or disables undo for ordinary identity changes. Those operations remain around the initial body-ready identity correction after the body and signature are assembled. Native bodyModified reads the editor document-modified state, and the close prompt checks that state alongside other changes. Keeping the manual path from resetting it preserves an existing reason to prompt; it does not establish autosave or recovery. The enabled reply test checks initial Delivered-To identity, not the full edited-draft/reselection sequence. No compose test ran.
title: Manual identity changes retain compose modification history
